hooks.command: bash -c 'O="$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "Unable to simultaneously satisfy constraints" && echo "💡 Auto Layout conflict. Try: skill auto-layout-debugging"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "Actor-isolated|Sendable|data race|@MainActor" && echo "💡 Concurrency issue. Try: skill swift-concurrency"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "no such column|FOREIGN KEY constraint|migration" && echo "💡 Database migration issue. Try: skill database-migration"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "retain cycle|memory leak|deinit.*never called" && echo "💡 Memory issue detected. Try: skill memory-debugging"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "CKError|CKRecord.*error" && echo "💡 CloudKit issue. Try: skill cloudkit-ref or cloud-sync-diag"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "ubiquitous.*error|iCloud Drive|NSFileCoordinator" && echo "💡 iCloud Drive issue. Try: skill icloud-drive-ref or cloud-sync-diag"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "file.*disappeared|file not found|storage.*full" && echo "💡 File storage issue. Try: skill storage-diag"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "FileProtection|data protection|file.*locked" && echo "💡 File protection issue. Try: skill file-protection-ref"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "error:.*module.*not found|linker command failed" && echo "💡 Build configuration issue. Try: /axiom:fix-build"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "Sandbox.*denied|sandbox.*violation|Operation not permitted.*sandbox" && echo "💡 macOS sandbox issue. Try: skill axiom-macos-file-handling"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "notarization.*failed|Unable to notarize|staple.*failed" && echo "💡 macOS notarization issue. Try: skill axiom-macos-distribution"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "Hardened Runtime|com.apple.security.*entitlement" && echo "💡 macOS entitlement issue. Try: skill axiom-macos-distribution"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "NSWindow.*error|window.*nil|orderFront.*failed" && echo "💡 macOS window issue. Try: skill axiom-macos-windows"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "NSDocument.*error|autosave.*failed|FileDocument.*error" && echo "💡 macOS document issue. Try: skill axiom-macos-document-apps"; echo "$O" | grep -qE "codesign.*failed|Code signature.*invalid|SecStaticCode" && echo "💡 macOS code signing issue. Try: skill axiom-macos-distribution"; exit 0'
bash -c 'if [[ "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.swift ]] && command -v swiftformat &>/dev/null; then swiftformat "$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" --quiet || true; fi; exit 0'
